client: Core client settings for Potsmod, including automatic updates and backend Wynncraft API endpoints.
gui: Customize the Potsmod Click GUI appearance, animations, theme colors, and layout scale.
view_model: Customize player first-person hand and item render positions, rotations, and scales.
inventory_calculator: Shows total raw emeralds and liquid emeralds calculated in your inventory and bank.
custom_territory_map: Revamped interactive full-screen Wynncraft territory guild map with live defense info.
defense_color_overlay: Renders colored defense overlays on territory maps based on tower upgrade level and defenses.
economy_sandbox: Interactive economy and territory production planning tool with mock rates and resource paths.
newest_world: Quick keybind to automatically detect and switch to the newest online Wynncraft world server.
world_map_hud: Displays a mini-map HUD showing live territory borders, routes, and defense colors in your world.
res_tick: Displays a countdown HUD overlay predicting when the next global territory resource tick occurs.
territory_route_flow: Draws animated flowing route connections between connected territories on the guild map.
territory_boxes: Displays 3D bounding box outlines around territory zones in the world.
consu_text: Displays remaining consumable duration timers and labels cleanly on your HUD.
tower_ehp: Calculates and displays effective health pool (EHP) numbers for enemy guild war towers.
radiance_sync: Live synchronized guild war coordinator HUD with team states, attack alerts, and timers.
chat_encryption: End-to-end encrypted chat messaging using AES-256-GCM for secret guild and squad communication.
auto_stream: Automatically sends /stream when entering Wynncraft to hide server info from stream snipers.
shout_filter: Filters and cleans up annoying public shout messages and spam in the chat.
